scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:setup: psql -d postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'content_discovery'" | grep -q 1 || createdb content_discovery && psql content_discovery -f db-schema.sql && npm run db:seed
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @discovery-hub/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @discovery-hub/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
